source_task_note: Four idea-generator subagents were dispatched in-session by the /propose-ideas skill (no dispatch queue, no goal_lanes claims): one lane each for AES, SHA-1, RSA, NFS/GNFS. Their handoff brief is recorded under handoff_brief below.

unused_id_reasons.IDEA-20260901-3aad9c: AES generator: remaining enumerated objects (key-schedule S-box word vector; super-box key-collision objects; AES-256 schedule bottleneck words; affine-patch weak-key class; imprimitivity systems) failed the lossy-projection test, were rediscoveries of the biclique/MITM or slide lanes, or were closed by Wernsdorf (KN-LIT-7062); filing a fourth for count would have been a fatigue-report entry.
unused_id_reasons.IDEA-20260901-eb0db5: NFS/GNFS generator: Galois-automorphism relation multiplication (polylog at best), sublattice/special-q divisibility forcing (net loss for d>=3), higher-dimensional sieving for two polynomials (worse norms), an LA-cost exponent below 2 (cost-matching term, not constant-setting) and implicit-row LA regeneration (constant) were considered and not filed.

questions_created_note: RQ-GNFS-c6ce52 was opened by this run because the directive named NFS and GNFS as targets and no existing question admits an idea about the number field sieve as an algorithmic object (RQ-RSA-afe33c is the cost-model question, RQ-SNFS-005666 the special-form question, RQ-PAIR-f2e31f the tower variant). Id minted with tools/allocate_id.py --next research_question --area GNFS and --check verified free. No goal record is opened for it; goal_id is null on its four proposals.
questions_unchanged_note: All seven pre-existing target questions and the bound goal records (GOAL-AES-002, GOAL-SHA1-001, GOAL-RSA-001, GOAL-RSA-002, GOAL-SNFS-001) were READ ONLY.
handoff_brief: Shared brief (scratchpad handoff-common.md, not committed): read the role contract, target profile, inventor protocol, KN-TECH-056/080, the target RQ(s) in full, the goal next_action, a per-lane dedup list of every existing proposal citing the target RQs, and the exemplar IDEA-20260901-e6ff3c for filing conventions; exponent-first search bias; mandatory heuristic_assumptions and target_complexity; proof_search_map for proof-oriented ideas; dominated_by checked against the frontier; citations with provenance; pre-allocated IDs only; YAML hygiene by construction; report the section-5 honest-accounting block. Lane briefs: AES (RQ-AES-002 primary, RQ-AES-001/003 by ceiling; 4 ids), SHA-1 (RQ-SHAONE-081e3a; 4 ids), RSA (RQ-RSA-d46f02 primary, at most one under RQ-RSA-afe33c, NFS ingredients excluded; 4 ids), NFS/GNFS (RQ-GNFS-c6ce52 primary, at most 2 under RQ-SNFS-005666; 6 ids).

Generators reached eprint.iacr.org / iacr.org / arXiv for several primary texts and abstracts (recorded per citation as retrieved with verified_by); sources that returned HTTP 403 or binary-only are recorded as recalled.
repairs_returned_to_generators_not_made_: IDEA-20260901-d88b5c citations[4] (DCC-2025 complexity-formulae paper) and IDEA-20260901-df12e1 citations[0] (Bisseling-Flesch 2006) were provenance retrieved without verified_by for sources the generator reported as metadata-only (HTTP 403). tools/validate_ledger.py rejected both. The generator has no Edit tool and rewrote each file via Write, declaring the content otherwise identical; the orchestrator holds no pre-repair copy, so that declaration is the generator's and is recorded as such. Both files re-pass the strict parse, the schema checker and the ledger validator.

scientific_boundary: This snapshot commit archives the filed IDEA records and the new research-question record byte-for-byte as PROPOSALS and a QUESTION only. No hypothesis, experiment, evidence or decision record is created and no status changes; approval is /design-experiment under Coordinator authority. Every filed record reports sota_delta +0 on every attack axis against its named baseline; no record claims an attack, speedup, closure or novelty above unverified. Generator-enumerated closures are the generators' claims, reviewed by nobody, and are not adopted by this archive.
self_neutrality: The receipt cannot embed its own final hash, size, commit SHA or parent SHA. Those remain null; every other declared path is hashed from its final pre-commit bytes under content_first.
